title: A good pillow, but overpriced
text: A good pillow, but overpriced. There is a lot to like about this pillow- I think the texture is nice, the foam is comfortable and it is very light. But there are no shortage of pillows that tick those boxes at lower price points. It doesn't have memory foam feel, it doesn't have cooling features, or any bells and whistles (if you can call them that) that you would normally find/expect in a pillow at this price point. This is a very good foam pillow, perhaps somewhat better for back sleepers than side sleepers (doesn't feel like a lot of support on my side, but very comfy on my back). Maybe I'm missing a feature that makes it worth more than other pillows of this class, but I'm finding it hard to see what makes this so expensive.
